project: COSMIC FRONTIER — NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026

modules.name: Solar System Major Planets Catalog
modules.source: NASA/JPL Solar System Dynamics & Horizons Ephemerides
modules.retrievalMethod: JPL Horizons API & IAU Reference Ephemerides

units.massEarthRelative: ratio relative to Earth mass (5.972e24 kg)

modules.knownLimitations: Elliptical orbits assume fixed mean Keplerian elements; real-time planetary perturbations require full numerical N-body integration.

modules.name: Confirmed Exoplanet Archive Catalog
modules.retrievalMethod: TAP (Table Access Protocol) ADQL query over table 'ps'
modules.knownLimitations: Bounded sample query limited to confirmed planets with measured radius; unmeasured properties preserved as null.

modules.name: JPL Asteroids, Comets & Trans-Neptunian Objects
modules.source: NASA/JPL Solar System Dynamics Small-Body Database (SBDB)
modules.retrievalMethod: REST query over ssd-api.jpl.nasa.gov/sbdb.api and sb_radar.api
modules.dataStatus: Real Archival Data (with 1 distinctly separated hypothetical scenario)
modules.knownLimitations: Planet X is strictly segregated into hypotheticalScenarios and identified as unconfirmed.

modules.name: Extragalactic Deep-Sky Targets
modules.knownLimitations: Cosmic distances are based on standard Lambda-CDM cosmological parameters (H0 = 67.8 km/s/Mpc).

modules.name: CDS SIMBAD Benchmark Stellar Catalog
modules.retrievalMethod: SIMBAD TAP ADQL query over table 'basic'
modules.knownLimitations: Selected primary benchmark stars for observational and calibration comparison.

modules.name: SPHEREx Mission Architecture & IRSA Schema
modules.source: NASA/IPAC Infrared Science Archive (IRSA) & SPHEREx Science Office
modules.retrievalMethod: IRSA ObsCore TAP Schema & Mission White Paper specifications
modules.knownLimitations: SPHEREx is scheduled for launch; current public IRSA products represent pre-flight calibration pipelines.

modules.name: NASA Image and Video Library Archival Imagery
modules.knownLimitations: Images are subject to official NASA image use guidelines and retain original NASA identifiers.
